entries.what: Slept 8 to 1 after Sunday night shift, then skipped lunch to catch the Tule Line to Bayshore for the afternoon section.
entries.outcome: Made Biomechanics half-awake and took notes on his phone.

entries.what: Rode his bike to Ridgeline for the 10 p.m. shift and got sent to the cold dock by José.
entries.outcome: Worked the freezer area in his jacket all night.

entries.what: Got home at 7, ate eggs and rice, and slept until 1. Phone battery died at 4 a.m. on shift again, so he leaned on his power bank.
entries.outcome: Got some sleep and charged up.

entries.what: Tuesday off class. Did laundry at home, called Jade on a break before her clinic lab, then tried to get a quick nap before shift.
entries.outcome: Short call, planned Saturday dinner.

entries.what: Night shift on the cold dock. Trevor griped about another rate talk while they restacked totes.
entries.outcome: Marcus kept rate and avoided trouble.

entries.what: Met academic advisor Marissa Holt after his section. She told him his GPA is 2.4 and he needs 2.7 to stay in kinesiology.
entries.outcome: Left with a warning and a number he can't stop thinking about.

entries.what: Told Arjun at the apartment about the meeting, and Arjun started offering ideas. Marcus cut it off and went to get ready for shift.
entries.outcome: Slightly tense, no argument.

entries.what: Worked the night shift on the cold dock with Holt's number in his head.
entries.outcome: Hit rate and got through the shift.

entries.what: After a few hours of sleep, he mapped out a GPA recovery plan with weekly study blocks, Fatima's notes and a stats fix, treating Holt's warning as a job to fix.
entries.outcome: Wrote the plan on his phone and sent Fatima a note asking for her docs.

entries.what: Attended his Thursday afternoon section and read Fatima's Biomechanics notes during the break.
entries.outcome: Caught up on one missed lecture.

entries.what: Clocked in at Ridgeline and worked the cold dock until the morning.
entries.outcome: Smooth shift, no write-up.

entries.what: Got home at 7, then got a bad Stats result: a D after the first two quizzes. Slept late into the afternoon.
entries.outcome: Grade stuck at a D, pushing tutoring up his list.

entries.what: Payday. Sent money to his mom and paid for a Taquería Colima burrito as his breakfast treat. Hit the gym for a short lift.
entries.outcome: Mom fund went out and his lift was short.

entries.what: Friday off from classes. Night shift on the cold dock; Marcus skipped dinner prep to nap first.
entries.outcome: Worked the night without issue.

entries.what: After another bad Stats quiz, Marcus looked up the resale value of a sneaker release and wondered if it'd pay off, eyeing the box wall in his closet.
entries.outcome: Didn't buy yet but kept the tab open.

entries.what: Saturday evening at Phở Bến Thành with Jade. He kept it light and avoided talking about Holt.
entries.outcome: Good night, but she noticed he seemed distracted.

entries.what: Biked to Ridgeline for his shift and took the cold dock.
entries.outcome: Worked through the night.

entries.what: Slept from 8 to 1 after the Saturday shift, then did his Sunday meal prep: chicken and rice in five containers.
entries.outcome: Prep done for the week.

entries.what: Arjun mentioned the Delgado Park harvest farmers market and Marcus went along to grab fruit.
entries.outcome: Bought peaches and ate a tamale.

entries.what: Left for the 10 p.m. Ridgeline shift on his bike with Sunday night ahead.
entries.outcome: Started the new week on the cold dock.
